concept: RDS Read Replicas: offload reads from the primary
tests: Offloading primary CPU from reporting SELECT queries.
expected: Create one or more Read Replicas and point reports at their endpoint. Triggers: "CPU-bound due to reporting SELECTs", "offload read load".
why_not: Multi-AZ standby does not serve reads; backup retention and PITR are data protection, not read scaling.
